title: §.XIII: Affirmative on both — Crocius, Ausführliche Behauptung, Pauli, Faculty Senior vs Liebhard; Diet 1566
pass_a_gloss: The true affirmative of each — especially of the latter, which necessarily presupposes and infers the truth of the former — Joh. Crocius has more fully proved in the German Tract alleged above and in his thicker Commentary, question the second; likewise the Author of the ausführlichen Behauptung from p. 90 to 111; Georgius Pauli in the Reformato Augustano; and the Venerable Senior of our Faculty against Liebhard in chapters 4 and 6 entire, among other proofs, chiefly from the Augsburg Diet of the Year 1566 (of which Joh. Crocius cites most fully in Comment. Cap. 18), Cap. 4 §. 8 p. 102;
pass_b_english: On both questions — especially the second, which must presuppose and imply the first — the affirmative is true.

Joh. Crocius proved it at length in the German tract already cited and in his denser Commentary, question 2; so did the author of the Ausführliche Behauptung, pp. 90–111; Georgius Pauli in the Reformatus Augustanus; and the venerable Senior of our faculty against Liebhard in chapters 4 and 6 entire.
Among other proofs they lean chiefly on the Augsburg Diet of 1566 (treated most fully by Crocius, Comm. Cap. 18), Cap. 4 §.8 p. 102;
source_text: Utriusque, cumprimis posterioris, affirmativam veram & prioris Veritatem necessariò supponentem inferentemque, prolixius evicerunt Joh. Crocius, Tractatu Germanico suprâ allegato, & Commentario suo spissiori, quaestione secunda, Auctor item der ausführlichen Behauptung à pag. 90. ad 111., Georgius Pauli in Reformato Augustano, & Venerandus Facultatis nostrae Senior contra Liebhardum cap. 4. & sexto integris, inter alias probationes, maximè ex Comitio Anni 1566.
